vlm.recording: first-person GoPro snowboarding recording (helmet or chest mount)
vlm.audio: wind noise at speed, the rider and friends nearby
vlm.describe: the terrain (groomed run, trees, powder, park), jumps (take-off, air, landing), falls, friends on camera and what they do, lift rides, standing around or talking, indoor scenes and views
vlm.hype: 0-1 standing around, riding a lift, indoors; 3-4 ordinary cruising; 6-7 fast riding, powder spray, tight trees, a small jump; 8-10 a big jump, a crash or fall, a spectacular line, a near miss.
vlm.idle: lifts, standing around and lodge scenes
vlm.rate_high: jumps, crashes, powder spray, fast riding, tight trees, friends doing something funny, a stunning view
vlm.rate_low: riding a chairlift, standing around, the lodge, the ground or the sky only
vlm.retry_high: jumps, crashes, powder and fast riding
vlm.retry_low: chairlifts, standing around and the lodge
